source.name: Footy Headlines: Tunisia 2026 World Cup Home, Away & Third Kits Released
source.note: Kit maker. The launch write-up and the Kappa product photos show only the Kappa Omini and the Tunisia crest on the white home shirt, with no commercial logo on the front, sleeves or back (a small Omini sits at the nape); the shorts carry only 'TUN'. Kappa is the technical sponsor of the Tunisia men's national team. No other sponsor could be found on any placement.
source.quote: The central Kappa Omini logo and the traditional Tunisia national team crest are rendered in bold red.

summary: Kappa home kit for the 2026 World Cup. No commercial shirt sponsor: the Kappa Omini and the Tunisia crest are the shirt's only marks, on front, sleeves and back; the shorts carry only the 'TUN' team code.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Kappa makes the kit.
